title: "Step 3: Surrogate time series"   
output: html_document
---

Step1. Lag vars and Set parameters
```{r chunk07_1}
#all_vars <- c("RSV","INF_A","INF_B","PIV","ADV","HMPV","Vaccine")
all_vars <- c(virus_name,"INF_A","INF_B","INF_ALL","Vaccine","Temp","AH")
data_country_clean <-  data_country.norm[, c("year_decimal","date", all_vars)]
```


Step2. Generate surrogate data for permutation tests
```{r chunk07_2}
seed = 2311
sur_num <- 100
sam_num <- 100

set.seed(seed)
#Generates surrogate data by randomizing the phases of a Fourier transform, preserving the power spectra of the null surrogates
data_country_ebi <- lapply(all_vars, function(var) {
  SurrogateData(data_country_clean[[var]], method = "ebisuzaki", num_surr = sur_num, T_period =  12)
})
names(data_country_ebi) <- paste0(all_vars, "_ebi")

set.seed(seed)
#Generates surrogate data by  computing a mean seasonal trend of the specified period and shuffling the residuals
data_country_sea<- lapply(all_vars, function(var) {
  SurrogateData(data_country_clean[[var]], method = "seasonal", num_surr = sur_num, T_period = 12, alpha =0.1)
  })
names(data_country_sea) <- paste0(all_vars, "_sea")

set.seed(seed)
#Generates surrogate data by randomly permuting the values of the original time series
data_country_ran<- lapply(all_vars, function(var) {
  SurrogateData(data_country_clean[[var]], method = "random_shuffle", num_surr = sur_num, T_period =  12)
  })
names(data_country_ran) <- paste0(all_vars, "_ran")

data_country_ebi <- as.data.frame(data_country_ebi)
data_country_sea <- as.data.frame(data_country_sea)
data_country_ran <- as.data.frame(data_country_ran)

data_country_obs_null <- cbind(data_country_clean,data_country_ebi,data_country_sea,data_country_ran)
data_country_obs_null <- data_country_obs_null %>%
  select(-date)
data_country_clean <- data_country_clean %>%
  select(-date)
```

### Visualization of surrogate time series
```{r chunk07_3,fig.width=24, fig.height=18, dpi=300}
plots_list <- list()
for (var in all_vars) {
    plot_null_model <- ggplot(data_country_obs_null, aes(year_decimal, group=1)) +
      geom_line(aes(x=year_decimal, y=.data[[paste0(var,"_ran.1")]], color="Random surrogate"), size=1) +
      geom_line(aes(x=year_decimal, y=.data[[paste0(var,"_ebi.1")]], color="Ebisuzaki surrogate"), size=1) +
      geom_line(aes(x=year_decimal, y=.data[[paste0(var,"_sea.1")]], color="Seasonal surrogate"), size=1) +
      geom_line(aes(x=year_decimal, y=.data[[var]], color="Observed"), size=1) +
      labs(x="Time (week)", y=paste0(var, " (standardised)"), color="",title = country_name) +
      scale_colour_manual(values = c("Observed" = 'black', "Ebisuzaki surrogate" = "#377eb8", 
                                     "Seasonal surrogate" = '#e74c3c',"Random surrogate"='#f1c40f' )) +
      mytheme +
      guides(colour = guide_legend(ncol = 2))+
      theme(panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill=NA, size=1),
            legend.position = "bottom",panel.grid.major.x=element_blank(),
            panel.grid.major.y=element_blank()) 
  
  plots_list[[which(var==all_vars)]] <- plot_null_model
}

grid_arrange <- grid.arrange(grobs = plots_list, ncol = 3, nrow = 5, align = "hv")
grid_arrange
output_name <- paste("02_output/02_CCM/01_Null_Model_Data/", country_index, "_", country_name, sep="")
file_name = paste(output_name, "_surrogate.pdf", sep="")
ggsave(file_name, grid_arrange, width = 24, height = 18)
```
